title: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026- Apply Offline for Project Assistant Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai) has released an official notification for the recruitment of Various Project Assistant Jobs. Candidates with M.E/ M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering can apply for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 . Interested and eligible candidates can send their application form and resume to the email address mentioned below.
